mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, projected_through_sequence, owner_id, lease_until, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_creative_message_projection WHERE run_id = #{runId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE manga_creative_message_projection SET owner_id = #{owner}, lease_until = #{until}, updated_by = #{owner}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND (owner_id IS NULL OR owner_id = #{owner} OR lease_until <= #{now})
